description: AstroMedix Dynamics is building BioAstris Edge: an autonomous, offline clinical AI and biometric monitoring system for deep-space astronauts facing communication blackouts. We fuse vital-sign telemetry, vocal biomarkers, and NASA ExMC protocols to deliver sub-second medical triage on local edge hardware. We are seeking biomedical engineers, edge ML developers, clinical advisors, and UX designers to join us in Azare!
